critical_code_review_comments: analysis_engine.py is approaching size threshold — main agent already noted pre-existing E701/F841 lint warnings (not regressions). Consider splitting per-module helpers (_sim_analysis, _cell_colocation, _bulk_transfer_analysis) into a /app/backend/analysis/ subpackage if file exceeds 700 lines.

Empty/legacy case 7c958508-... still returns has_volume_data=true because byte counts exist on its IPDR rows. This is correct behavior; UI shows the bulk panel with non-zero volumes, so no empty-state is triggered for that subsection. Worth documenting that bulk-transfer empty-state is data-shape-driven (only triggers when zero IPDR sessions), not feature-flag-driven.
Both DOCX (40 KB) and PDF (9.3 KB) reports stream successfully, but PDF text extraction requires pdfminer; consider documenting expected text extractability for downstream consumers.
